component.name: Clipdeck
component.summary: Play sound clips into your microphone

description.p: Clipdeck is a fast soundboard for Linux and Windows. It creates a virtual microphone (“Clipdeck Mic” on PipeWire, VB-CABLE on Windows) that mixes your real microphone with sound clips, so friends in Discord, games and streams hear them.

ul.li: Global hotkeys, fuzzy search, categories, favorites
Loudness normalization (EBU R128), trim, loop, playback modes
Imports and exports Soundpad sound lists (.spl)
